vibe.verdict: A good night-shift cafeteria that fits the hospital setting, with a couple of the film's props waiting to be used.
missing: 'Samhain' written in blood on the blackboard (the elementary school)
The razor blade in the pirate boy's candy apple (the opening hospital scene)
Jimmy slipping in Mrs Alves's blood (the corridor)
Karen scalded in the therapy tub (the therapy room)
Laurie learning she is Michael's sister (the dream)
The flammable gas in the operating room (the finale)
ideas: Swap 'Night shift egg sandwiches' note for the Samhain blackboard: 'Special: Samhain stew'
Swap 'Haddonfield candy apples' note for the pirate boy: 'Do not bite'
Swap 'Night shift mulled apple juice' note for the therapy tub: 'Served hot, watch the tub'
Swap the 'Meal Ticket' line for 'Ward 3, Jimmy's shift'
